title: A lone 5 mm Fill square with under sewing, as PE-DESIGN sews it
description: A 5 x 5 mm Rectangle-tool square, Fill at PE-DESIGN's defaults (under sewing on, density 4.5, Direction 45). PE-DESIGN 11.50 starts on the under sewing's edge run 1 mm inside the outline at the point nearest the entry (the middle of the bottom edge) and sews the 3 mm inset loop once round. It then sews the under sewing's rows in two halves from the start (the corner row nearest, back to the start and straight across to the far corner row, the diagonal), ends on the start and steps out to the entry before the top fill (#1088).

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference stitches/fill-square-5mm-under-sewing.pes (round 15, optimiser off): 85 stitches, the same at five positions 0,5 mm apart

references.make: 100 x 100 mm page, Optimize Entry/Exit Points off. Rectangle tool, 5 x 5 mm at (40, 47.5) mm (Home > Size). Line Not Sewn, region Fill Stitch at its defaults. Save As PES.
